title: Keys, quotas, rate limits and spend control

videos.script: Every API in this course ends in the same place: a key, and a bill attached to it. This last lesson is about keeping both under control. {{keys}} A key is money. It lives in the environment, never in a file that gets shared and never in a page a browser downloads. {{rate-limits}} Providers limit how fast you may ask. Read the headers, and wait when they say to, instead of failing in a burst. {{caps}} Providers also cap how much you may spend: per account, and at a router per key. Set yours below theirs. {{budget}} And the nearest limit is the one in your own code. A loop that asks until it likes the answer can spend all night. A budget that counts every response stops it in a minute.
